tagline: Match colors, clear squares, and every move becomes part of the song.
description:
EDMIA is a color matching puzzle set to electronic music. Slide and rotate falling pieces to build squares of one color. A sweep line crosses the board and clears them, and every move you make plays into the track.

Five levels, each with its own sound: Midnight, Daybreak, Neon, Fever and Ascend.

The free demo plays Midnight and Daybreak. Buy it to unlock Neon, Fever and Ascend.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser. Headphones recommended. Post your initials on the high score board.
